name: pumba
description: Tourism Journey Orchestration Platform — monorepo root

scripts.install:all: pnpm install && cd apps/api && uv sync
scripts.check: pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run boundaries && pnpm run test
scripts.verify: pnpm run lint:api && pnpm run typecheck:api && pnpm run boundaries && pnpm run coverage && pnpm run verify:openapi && pnpm run verify:contracts && pnpm -r typecheck && pnpm -r lint && pnpm -r test && pnpm -r build && pnpm run bandit
scripts.verify:openapi: pnpm run openapi && git diff --exit-code -- packages/contracts/openapi/openapi.yaml
scripts.lint:api: cd apps/api && uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check .
scripts.typecheck:api: docker compose run --rm api uv run mypy apps ports config
scripts.test: pnpm run test:api && pnpm -r test && pnpm -r build
scripts.coverage: docker compose run --rm api pytest --cov --cov-report=term-missing --cov-fail-under=80 && docker compose run --rm api coverage report --include="apps/*/domain/*,apps/common/authz/*,apps/common/geo.py,apps/common/money.py,apps/common/reference.py,apps/common/state_machine.py" --fail-under=95
scripts.bandit: docker compose run --rm api uv run --with bandit bandit -r apps ports config -ll
scripts.format: cd apps/api && uv run ruff check --fix . && uv run ruff format .
scripts.seed: docker compose run --rm api python manage.py seed
scripts.seed:check: docker compose run --rm api python manage.py seed --dry-run
scripts.openapi: docker compose run --rm -e DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE=config.settings.ci api python manage.py spectacular --file /contracts/openapi/openapi.yaml --validate --fail-on-warn
